objectives.title: Forge a valid JWT
objectives.prompt: crAPI's token handling has several JWT weaknesses. Get a token the platform accepts for the admin account and read the name of the profile video on admin's dashboard: that name is the flag.
hints: Look at how the identity service publishes its keys and which JWT header fields it trusts.
Not every endpoint verifies the token's signature the same way: compare the dashboard with the others.

steps.title: Read the token
steps.prompt: Which signing algorithm do the tokens crAPI issues use? (JWT alg name)

steps.title: Find the public key
steps.prompt: Under which well-known file name does crAPI publish its signing keys? (file name only)

objectives.title: Access details of another user's vehicle
objectives.prompt: Leak the location of a vehicle that belongs to another user (one of the community post authors). The latitude it reports is the flag.
hints: Vehicle IDs are GUIDs, so find an API response that hands out other users' vehicle IDs.
Then look for an endpoint that takes a vehicle ID and returns where the vehicle is.

objectives.title: Access mechanic reports of other users
objectives.prompt: Read a mechanic report submitted by another user. The service reference at the end of its problem details is the flag.
hints: Submit a 'contact mechanic' request yourself and read the whole response.
The report endpoint takes an identifier: what happens with one that isn't yours?

objectives.title: Reset the password of a different user
objectives.prompt: Take over the account of robot001@example.com through the password reset flow and read the name of the profile video on its dashboard: that name is the flag.
hints: The reset flow ends with a short one-time code. How many tries does each version of the check endpoint allow?
REST APIs are predictable: older versions of an endpoint may still be served.

objectives.title: Find an endpoint that leaks other users' data
objectives.prompt: Find the API response that exposes sensitive data of other users. What is the vehicle ID of the author of the community post 'Title 3'?
hints: Watch the API calls the Community page makes and read every field of each post's author.

objectives.title: Find an internal property of a video
objectives.prompt: Upload a profile video and find the internal property of the video resource the API should not expose. What is that property called?
hints: Read the full response of the video endpoints, not only what the page shows.

objectives.title: Layer 7 DoS through 'contact mechanic'
objectives.prompt: The 'contact mechanic' request can make the workshop service call another API over and over. Which request field sets how many times it repeats the call?
hints: Read the JSON body the page sends when you contact a mechanic.

objectives.title: Delete a video of another user
objectives.prompt: Find the function-level authorization flaw that lets a regular user delete someone else's video. Which privilege level does the path of the endpoint you used belong to? (one word)
hints: REST paths are predictable: the user video endpoint has a sibling for a more privileged role.

objectives.title: Get an item for free
objectives.prompt: Get refunded for an order you never returned, using a shadow endpoint that edits an order's properties. Which order property did you change to get the refund?
hints: Mass assignment: the API accepts more properties than the page ever sends.
Look for an HTTP method on a single order that the page does not use.

objectives.title: Increase your balance by $1,000 or more
objectives.prompt: After the free item, get a refund large enough to raise your balance by $1,000 or more. Which order property scales the amount refunded?
hints: The refund is computed from the order: which of its numbers can you control?

objectives.title: Update internal video properties
objectives.prompt: Change the internal property of your profile video found earlier. Which HTTP method does the video endpoint accept for the change?
hints: The page renames videos: see which request it sends and what else that request accepts.

objectives.title: Make crAPI send a request for you
objectives.prompt: Make the workshop service send an HTTP request to a URL you choose and return the response (the lab has no internet, so aim at a host inside it). Which request field carries the URL the server calls?
hints: One feature makes the server call another API on your behalf: read the body it sends.

objectives.title: Get a free coupon without its code
objectives.prompt: Make the coupon validation endpoint return a coupon without knowing any coupon code. The code of the coupon it returns is the flag.
hints: The community service keeps coupons in MongoDB and passes your JSON to its query.
Look up NoSQL injection with query operators.

objectives.title: Redeem a coupon twice through the database
objectives.prompt: The coupon redemption check builds its SQL query from your input. Use SQL injection against it to read the table flags of the crapi database.
hints: The workshop service checks applied coupons in PostgreSQL with a query built from the coupon code.
Find out how many columns the query returns and what the database is.

objectives.title: Find an endpoint without authentication
objectives.prompt: Find the endpoint that answers without any authentication and read an order placed by another user. Its transaction ID is the flag.
hints: Replay the shop's API calls without the Authorization header.
Order IDs are small integers.
